labels.name: Stimulates brain and arterial receptors
labels.note: OpenStax prints 'brain and arterial receptors': these are the central chemoreceptors in the medulla and the peripheral chemoreceptors in the carotid and aortic bodies (the course writes 'chemoreceptors', never a bare 'receptors'). The notes caption says so.
